conviction_note: Near non-result: the one company-level inference (a Q3 EPS bar of about RMB0.23 that needs operating income up about 47% q/q while management guided H2 gross margin lower and is consolidating a low-margin, 51%-owned distributor) leans negative. It is offset by a likely Q3 dividend decision on a stock trading at about net cash (Q3 2024 $0.01 and Q3 2025 $0.10 were both declared with the Q3 print), a UK pre-duty September stockpiling tailwind and a washed-out tape. The name sold its last miss by only about 3%, so p_up 48 on an abs move of 5.5 gives -0.22. impact_sum is -0.10, the same sign and size, so the two measurements agree.
bar: Q3 2026 consensus revenue RMB1.765bn and EPS CN¥0.23 per ADS (Chartmill, a single quarterly source, revenue estimate revised up 8.55% in 3 months; https://www.chartmill.com/stock/quote/RLX/estimates, snippet only, page returned 403). Cross-check: StockAnalysis FY2026 consensus, 6 analysts, revenue RMB5.89bn and non-GAAP EPS 0.90 (https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/rlx/forecast/, fetched 2026-11-19). Less H1 actuals (revenue 1,585.8m + 1,010.5m, diluted non-GAAP EPS 0.263 + 0.178), that implies H2 revenue of about RMB3.29bn (about 1.65bn a quarter) and H2 EPS of about 0.46 (about 0.23 a quarter), so the two sources roughly agree. Both may come from one S&P feed. There is no company numeric guide, only qualitative remarks: H2 international revenue lifted by consolidating the distributor, gross margin to normalize, mainland China broadly flat y/y. The bar is treated as soft, so sizes are kept small.
positioning_check: Short interest is small. About 5.2m ADS short, days to cover 2.0, settlement 2026-08-14 (StockMarketWatch, https://stockmarketwatch.com/stock/RLX/short-interest). 4.89m short, DTC 1.9, as of 2026-08-10 (https://shortsqueeze.com/?symbol=RLX). Borrow fee about 0.3% (https://curvedtrading.com/stocks/rlx/). No November figure was found. It is not a crowded short, so no squeeze mechanism. The baseline has no usable option chain: no implied move and no 25d skew. Put/call open-interest ratio is 0.17 (calls dominate, 3,235 total OI), which is thin and not a directional statement. Tape: spot $1.46 at the 52-week low, -6.4% over 5d, -11.0% over 20d, -41.8% from the 52-week high, 20d realised vol 27%. The stock is down about 25% since the Q2 print ($1.94 on 2026-08-16). Market cap is about $1.86bn (about 1.274bn basic ADS, derived from Q1 GAAP NI 294.2m / basic EPS 0.231) against RMB13.88bn = $2.05bn of cash and investments at 2026-06-30.

findings.finding: The Q3 EPS bar looks too high for the company's own disclosed run-rate. Q2 2026 non-GAAP net income was RMB238.8m on non-GAAP operating income of RMB149.6m. Non-operating income was therefore about RMB89m, against about RMB175m in Q2 2025, so interest and investment income roughly halved. Q2 diluted non-GAAP EPS was RMB0.178. Consensus of about RMB0.23 (about RMB308m of net income on about 1.34bn diluted ADS) needs operating income of about RMB220m, up about 47% q/q and above Q3 2025's RMB187.8m. That comes in a quarter where management said gross margin will normalize from Q2's 35.4%, the new distributor carries 'substantially lower margins' and 49% of its profit goes to minorities, and mainland China is guided flat y/y. The print-vs-bar lean is an EPS miss of roughly 10-25%, with revenue close to the bar.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 missed both revenue (about 14.5% under the forecast reference) and EPS, and the ADS slipped only about 3% to $1.94 (https://www.webull.com/news/15410169270387712, 2026-08-16). Q3 2025 beat revenue by $18.1m with EPS in line and closed +10.3% (https://finviz.com/news/230771/rlx-technology-rlx-climbs-10-on-q3-blowout, 2025-11-14). Misses are absorbed mildly and beats are paid.
findings.why_not_priced: The quarterly consensus was revised up 8.55% in three months (Chartmill), and the FY EPS consensus of 0.90 still implies an H2 at about 0.23 a quarter, so the estimates have not been cut toward Q2's 0.178 run-rate. If the market had priced a miss, estimates would show downward revisions. Instead the stock's 25% fall since August has come with no visible estimate cuts.
findings.independence: Q2 2025 comparison from a different release: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001828365/000110465925081600/tm2524178d1_ex99-1.htm (non-GAAP NI 291.2m vs op income 116.2m). Margin-normalization comment from Quartr's Q2 call summary: https://quartr.com/events/rlx-technology-inc-rlx-q2-2026_F3QeFjRS. The bar itself rests on Chartmill plus StockAnalysis, which may share one feed.

findings.finding: Q3 2026 is the first quarter that consolidates the Western European distributor in which RLX bought 51% and board control in July 2026 (about 30,000 retail endpoints and a digital ordering platform for about 20,000 merchants). Name, price, revenue and margin are undisclosed. The consensus step from Q2's RMB1,010.5m to RMB1,765m implies analysts have pencilled in about RMB450-650m a quarter of distributor revenue on top of about 15% organic growth on Q3 2025's RMB1,129.3m. The release will be the first disclosure of its actual scale and margin, and the direction is genuinely unknown.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The last unnamed European acquisition (May 2025) was first consolidated in Q3 2025, which drove revenue +49% y/y and a +10.3% close (https://finviz.com/news/230771/rlx-technology-rlx-climbs-10-on-q3-blowout).
findings.why_not_priced: The contribution is a number nobody outside the company has. The consensus is a guess at an undisclosed target, so the print resolves it either way. The 25% drawdown may reflect doubt about the guess, but no source states that.
findings.independence: Company release confirms the 51% stake and Q3 consolidation: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001828365/000110465926096395/tm2622298d1_ex99-1.htm. The lower-margin warning is in https://www.webull.com/news/15410169270387712.

findings.finding: The UK Vaping Products Duty (£2.20/10ml) started on 1 October 2026, and retail stockpiling surged in September: daily sales of covered products ran +50% all month, e-liquids and shortfills +78%, and the peak was +390% on 30 September, falling back to normal by 3 October (Vape and Go data). RLX's May/June 2025 European acquisition, described by the company as a 'long-established European e-vapor company with an integrated local retail and online footprint', is reported by 2Firsts to be UK retailer Totally Wicked, an e-liquid-heavy chain, through an entity with directors whose names match RLX executives. RLX has not confirmed this. If correct, Q3 European revenue carries a one-month pull-forward, and Q4 commentary carries a payback.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None specific. International revenue has been the line the stock trades on (Q3 2025 +10.3% on international-led growth).
findings.why_not_priced: The ownership link is unconfirmed and comes from a trade outlet, and the stockpiling data was published three days before the print. No preview ties it to RLX. If it were priced, the Q3 revenue estimate would carry a UK pull-forward and a Q4 cut, and nothing shows either. Net of the rest of the company the effect is small: the UK unit is perhaps 10-15% of revenue, and a one-month surge adds perhaps 1-2% to consolidated revenue.
findings.independence: Ownership lead: https://www.2firsts.com/news/uks-leading-e-cigarette-retailer-totally-wicked-acquired-actual-controller-suspected-to-be-relx-affiliated-company-2 (June 2025). Duty start: https://www.gov.uk/government/news/new-vaping-products-duty-comes-into-effect. This is a proxy: one retailer's data and an unconfirmed subsidiary.

findings.finding: Capital return: RLX has declared a dividend with its Q3 print two years running ($0.01/ADS with Q3 2024 on 2024-11-15; $0.10/ADS with Q3 2025 on 2025-11-14). It paid a $0.01 interim with Q2 2025 but declared nothing with Q2 2026. US$170m of buyback authorization remains through 2027. At $1.46 a repeat $0.10 is about a 6.8% yield, on a market cap of about $1.86bn against $2.05bn of cash and investments. Operating cash flow was -RMB63.2m in Q2 and cash fell RMB646m q/q, so the decision cuts both ways.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The $0.10 declaration arrived with the Q3 2025 blowout, which closed +10.3% (https://finviz.com/news/230771/rlx-technology-rlx-climbs-10-on-q3-blowout). The dividend's share of that move cannot be separated.
findings.why_not_priced: A stock that the market expected to keep paying about 7% with an enterprise value near zero would not sit at its 52-week low after a 25% slide. The skipped Q2 2026 interim may have led holders to expect a cut, which leaves room for a positive surprise if one is declared.
findings.independence: Q3 2024 dividend: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1828365/000110465924119690/tm2428594d1_ex99-1.htm. Q2 2025 interim: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001828365/000110465925081600/tm2524178d1_ex99-1.htm. Buyback remaining: https://www.nasdaq.com/press-release/rlx-technology-extends-us-500-million-share-repurchase-program-2025-12-31

findings.finding: RLX was deleted from the FTSE All-World Index effective 2026-09-21. The ADS closed $1.68 on 2026-09-18 on 44.77m shares against about 1.9m the day before, so that passive supply is spent. The stock has drifted to $1.46 since on roughly 1.6m a day.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: First session after the deletion: +2.4% to $1.72.
findings.why_not_priced: The deletion is public and done. All it explains is part of the drawdown, which is otherwise unexplained. Worth little on its own.

findings.finding: Smoore International, the main hardware supplier to Chinese closed-system brands, reported H1 2026 (released 2026-08-19) with China enterprise-customer revenue down 50.3% y/y and Q2 group growth slowing to about 1.9%. RLX is historically Smoore's largest China enterprise customer. This counterparty number covers a period RLX has already reported, and RLX guided mainland China broadly flat y/y for H2.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No resolved reaction to a China-segment surprise found; the Q2 2026 print with China-flat commentary moved -3%.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: it covers H1 and lands inside RLX's own China-flat remark. Part of the drop may reflect RLX sourcing elsewhere rather than weak sell-through. It is filed as a proxy.
findings.independence: Smoore interim announcement: https://www1.hkexnews.hk/listedco/listconews/sehk/2026/0819/2026081901471.pdf. RLX's China-flat outlook: https://quartr.com/events/rlx-technology-inc-rlx-q2-2026_F3QeFjRS

outside_window.finding: UK duty transition: unstamped pre-1 October stock may be sold until 2027-03-31 and transitional stamps are allowed to 2026-12-31. The Q4 payback in UK e-liquid volume shows up in the Q4 print (around March 2027), although Q3 call commentary on it falls inside the window and is covered by the stockpiling finding.
Malaysia's staged vape ban (open systems first, mid-2026 target, still unresolved per SEATCA's 30 June 2026 letter) is an Asian-market risk with no in-window date.
